chunks: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Abda al-Nishapuri narrated to us. He said: Abu al-Qasim Harun b. Ishaq narrated to us. He said: My uncle Ibrahim b. Muhammad narrated to us from Ziyad b. Alaqa and Abd al-Malik b. Umayr, from Jabir b. Samura. He said:

I was with my father in the presence of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and his family, and I heard him say: There will be twelve emirs after me. Then, he lowered his voice. So I said to my father: What did the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family, say softly? He said: He said: All of them are from Quraysh.

key_terms.أَمِيرًا: emirs/commanders — rulers who will govern after the Prophet
key_terms.اثْنَا عَشَرَ: twelve — the specific number of successors prophesied
key_terms.قُرَيْشٍ: Quraysh — the dominant tribe of Mecca from which the Prophet descended

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the twelve emirs who would come after him?
ai.summary: The Prophet (s) declares that twelve emirs will succeed him, all from the tribe of Quraysh. This hadith was narrated by the companion Jabir b. Samura, who overheard the Prophet while in his father's company. The lowered voice for the tribal identification suggests the sensitive political nature of this prophecy. This tradition is one of the most widely transmitted hadiths in both Sunni and Shia collections, understood by Shia scholars as referring to the Twelve Imams from the Prophet's household.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Abda al-Nishapuri narrated to us. He said: Abu’l Qasim Harun b. Ishaq narrated to us. He said: My uncle Ibrahim b. Muhammad narrated to us from Ziyad b. `Alaqa and `Abd al-Malik b. `Umayr from Jabir b. Samura. He said:

I was with my father in the presence of the Prophet (s). I heard him say: There will be twelve emirs after me. Then, his voice went soft. So, I said to my father: What did the Messenger of Allah (s) say softly? He said: He said: All of them are from Quraysh.
